takeaways: Tilting weights toward the bad-PV scenario has negligible effect on P95/worst in this model, suggesting the optimizer already hedges sufficiently via battery storage.
Both mean and tail improve under tilt2 (free lunch from improved planning): the battery can fully buffer the pessimistic hedge in this 8kWh / 4kW setup.
Symmetric weights (sym) remain the clean baseline: mean=1.7433 AUD, P95=3.2067 AUD, worst=3.7679 AUD.
These are stylised-model numbers; ratios between configurations are more reliable than absolute AUD values.
caveats: N=80 days; standard error of the mean ~ 0.0057 AUD.
aft_sd=0.3 creates afternoon PV uncertainty; the stochastic controller uses 3 scenarios (P10/P50/P90) generated by model.forecast -- weight tilting affects the LP objective blend.
CVaR comparison not run here; see the cvar_blend experiment for the direct cost comparison.
Stylised model: single deferrable, no battery degradation, flat load profile.
